ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which inflorescence type shown in the diagram is the widest?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image, from left to right, there are three labeled inflorescence schematic diagrams, respectively Panicle, Spike, and Receme. The Panicle on the left has many branches and flower buds extending to the left and right, and overall has the greatest horizontal spread; the Spike in the middle is basically arranged along one upright main axis and is relatively narrow; the Receme on the right is also mainly distributed around the central stem, and its horizontal width is smaller than the one on the left. Reasoning: Comparing the maximum horizontal widths of the three images, the side branches of the Panicle extend farthest to both sides, so it is the widest inflorescence type.
